comment: The two scaling tables are literals at CLK.cpp:13-16. The master runs at 48 ticks per main-clock cycle (line 194), and the three trigger modes set the pulse length through maxDuty at lines 198-210: Gate uses INT16_MAX so duty always comes out as half the period, Original uses 24 ticks, and Trigger uses max(1, (1e-3/tickTime)/48), which only exceeds one tick above about 60000 BPM and so is always exactly one master tick in practice. The theme and default-theme menu items are cosmetic and every module in the plugin carries them, so they are not written as lines.
